title: Echo Announcements
description: A modern, lightweight announcement plugin with MiniMessage, PlaceholderAPI, join messages, sounds, and multiple display types.
body:
# A powerful yet lightweight announcement plugin for Paper servers.

## Features:
- Automatic announcements (ordered or random)
- Chat, Actionbar, and Title support
- Fully customizable templates
- MiniMessage formatting (gradients, colors, styles)
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Join messages
- Configurable sounds
- Per-announcement settings
- Reload command

Designed to be simple to use but powerful enough for real servers.

Found a bug? Report it here:
https://discord.gg/fPzrA5TVm9
